tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Simulated paid bookings of the authenticated user, with no stored card data. GET pagination defaults to page 0, limit 100 (max 100).

tags.name: Booking Drafts
tags.description: Save and remove personal booking drafts. Drafts expire 24 hours after saving and do not reserve or unlock a vehicle. Lists use zero-based page numbers and a maximum page size of 100.

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Reserve vehicles and manage the booking lifecycle: create, start, complete, cancel, list and archive bookings of the authenticated user.

put.description: Mark the booking as started so the ride begins. Requires a destination set beforehand (409 otherwise).

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

post.description: Mark the booking as started so the ride begins. Requires a destination set beforehand (409 otherwise).

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

put.description: Store the free destination point and its estimate. Free while the booking is reserved; once the ride is in progress every change adds a fixed fee that is charged on completion.

422.description: Destination farther than 60 km from the pickup station

put.description: Mark a completed or cancelled booking of the authenticated user as archived. The booking is kept and still returned by the list endpoints with archived=true.

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

409.description: Booking is still reserved or in progress

get.description: List the bookings of the authenticated user, optionally filtered by vehicle.

parameters.name: vehicleId
parameters.description: Optional vehicle ID used to filter the bookings

post.description: Reserve a vehicle for the authenticated user between a start and an end location. The userId in the body must match the authenticated account.

409.description: Critical scooter battery below 15 percent or vehicle already reserved in that time range

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

post.description: Owner only. Score 1–5, optional comment up to 1000 characters and fixed tags. Returns 409 if not completed or already rated; 400 for invalid input.
Estimate distance, minutes and cost of riding from the booking's pickup station to a free point. Nothing is saved. changeFee is only charged when the ride already started.

422.description: Destination farther than 60 km from the pickup station

post.description: Finish the booking and atomically persist cost, distance, duration, average speed, an optional rating and up to 5000 observed GPS coordinates. Missing routeCoordinates stores an empty route.

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

get.description: List only the authenticated user's drafts whose server expiry is in the future, ordered by most recently saved. Pagination uses a zero-based page and a page size; returns an empty list when there are no unexpired drafts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of drafts per page, from 1 to 100

400.description: Page must be non-negative and limit must be between 1 and 100

post.description: Create a draft for an existing vehicle with a valid calendar date, local time and duration of 0.25 to 24 hours. The server supplies the owner, UUID, savedAt and expiresAt (24 hours after saving). A draft does not check availability, create a reservation or send reminder messages; reminder fields preserve the selected preferences.

400.description: Missing or invalid vehicle ID, date, time or duration

201.description: Draft saved; Location header contains the new draft URL

403.description: The userId in the body refers to another account

get.description: Return one booking owned by the authenticated user, without the recorded route (use the history detail for that).

patch.description: Cancel a booking of the authenticated user without deleting it.

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

get.description: List completed, paid bookings of the authenticated account as simulated payments, ordered by the latest ride completion. Pagination uses a zero-based page and a page size. Returns an empty list when no paid bookings exist; this endpoint does not process payments or expose card details.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Optional account ID; must match the authenticated user

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of payments per page, from 1 to 100

400.description: Page must be non-negative and limit must be between 1 and 100

403.description: The userId filter refers to another account

get.summary: Get a simulated payment by ID
get.description: Retrieve the payment derived from an owned booking. The payment ID is the booking UUID; only bookings with completed status and paid payment status are returned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Payment ID, equal to the booking UUID

404.description: Booking not found or it is not completed and paid

get.description: Sum final costs of all completed, paid bookings of the authenticated account. This is the full simulated spending total rather than the sum of the current payment-list page.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Optional account ID; must match the authenticated user

403.description: The userId filter refers to another account

get.description: Return one booking owned by the authenticated user together with its vehicle, start and end stations and, while the booking is reserved or in progress, the vehicle's current battery and the latest unlock request with its access code.

403.description: The resource belongs to another user

get.description: Page completed bookings owned by the authenticated account, including persisted metrics, final cost and recorded route. Old rides remain visible with an empty route.
Return one completed booking owned by the authenticated account with its recorded route and ride metrics.
Tell whether a vehicle is free between start and end (ISO-8601 instants) and list its busy slots. Slots are anonymous.

delete.description: Permanently remove a draft owned by the authenticated user. Expired drafts can also be deleted; deleting a draft does not affect reservations.

BookingResource.description: A booking of a vehicle made by a user, with its status, costs, payment and ride metrics.

TripRouteCoordinate.description: A GPS observation recorded during the ride; latitude [-90,90], longitude [-180,180].

DestinationResource.description: Free destination point of a ride. address is the human readable text resolved by the client and is ignored when quoting.

CreateBookingResource.description: Data required to reserve a vehicle. userId must match the authenticated account. startDate, endDate and totalCost are optional: omit them for an immediate ride.

DestinationQuoteResource.description: Estimated cost of riding to a destination. discount stays at 0 until plans grant benefits. changeFee is charged only when the ride already started. total = estimatedCost - discount + changeFee.

routeCoordinates.description: Optional observed route, up to 5000 valid GPS coordinates; omitted means no route was recorded.

routeSource.description: Origin of the route: gps (default) or simulated when it was interpolated between stations.

CompleteBookingResource.description: Final ride data used to complete a booking: costs, distance, duration, average speed and optional rating.

userId.description: Optional account ID; must match the authenticated user

selectedDate.description: Valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format

unlockTime.description: Valid local time in HH:mm format

duration.description: Requested duration in hours, from 0.25 to 24

smsReminder.description: Saved SMS reminder preference; does not send an SMS

emailConfirmation.description: Saved email confirmation preference; does not send an email

pushNotification.description: Saved push notification preference; does not send a push notification

CreateBookingDraftResource.description: Booking form values to save for later. Saving does not reserve a vehicle or check its availability.

selectedDate.description: Saved local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format

unlockTime.description: Saved local time in HH:mm format

smsReminder.description: Saved SMS reminder preference; does not send an SMS

emailConfirmation.description: Saved email confirmation preference; does not send an email

pushNotification.description: Saved push notification preference; does not send a push notification

savedAt.description: Server timestamp at which the draft was saved

expiresAt.description: Server expiry timestamp, 24 hours after savedAt

BookingDraft.description: Private saved booking form. Server expiry is 24 hours after saving; the draft does not reserve or unlock the vehicle.

id.description: Payment ID, equal to the booking UUID

amount.description: Final booking cost in the indicated currency

method.description: Booking payment method; card is exposed as credit_card

transactionId.description: Local simulated reference: booking- followed by the booking UUID

processedAt.description: Server timestamp at which the booking ended

description.description: Booking description containing the vehicle ID

PaymentResource.description: Simulated payment derived from a completed, paid booking. No real charge, card number or CVV is stored.

totalSpent.description: Sum of final costs; zero when no paid bookings exist

PaymentSummary.description: Total spent on all completed, paid bookings of the authenticated user, independent of payment-list pagination.

BookingDetailsResource.description: Everything the owner can see about one booking in a single response: the booking plus its vehicle, stations and latest unlock request.

UnlockSummary.description: Latest unlock request; only present while the booking is reserved or in progress

currentBattery.description: Battery right now, not at booking time; only present while the booking is reserved or in progress

VehicleSummary.description: Null when the vehicle no longer exists

BookingHistoryResource.description: A page of completed bookings for the authenticated account, newest completed ride first. Historical bookings without recorded GPS return an empty route.

VehicleAvailabilityResource.description: Whether a vehicle is free in a time range, plus its busy slots. Slots are anonymous: they never expose who booked.
